name: Holding a request to a measure
vision_statement: Every request is held to a measure until its goal is met.
opportunities: Translating a request into a metric, creating and editing the specs and metrics, judging goal completion, replanning an unmet goal and judging response quality are five ML tasks, each improvable on its own accuracy.
solution_coherence: Critical Thinking holds a request to a measure. Metric Translation turns the request into a metric with a target value or improvement and a budget, adjustable while the work runs. ESOI Application records that metric as a spec and applies the principles, creating and editing specs and metrics. Goal Completion says whether the goal's condition was met against its done-standard. When it was not, the composition's pursue step uses the untried read-only means within a budget before the response is sent, says once that the rest is still being worked on when the work is long, and otherwise reports what was tried and what is missing. Response Quality judges the response against the quality profile resolved for the request.
